# Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Validation

List the exact commands, GPU, CUDA version, and test models used. For solver
changes, include correctness and iteration-count comparisons against the
current baseline.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the public API backward compatible or documented the break.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated user-facing documentation where needed.
- [ ] I checked the changed files for generated artifacts and private paths.
- [ ] I reported skipped tests and known limitations.
